design_philosophy: A cinematic, immersive, and premium 3D digital agency experience. We fuse the deep, moody tension of high-end luxury with the raw, synthetic energy of neon violet glowing accents. Color is not used as a blanket, but as a light source. Every component must feel architectural, with generous negative space and fluid, physics-based interactions.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[6rem] tracking-tighter leading-none font-black
scale.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold
scale.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-zinc-500 font-medium

rules: No Inter or generic sans-serif fonts for any headings.
Main headline must use a bold masking text effect (e.g. background-clip: text with a subtle gradient or texture, or staggered Framer Motion reveal).
Avoid centering paragraphs. Keep dense text left-aligned for tension.
Use massive spacing between major sections (py-32 minimum).
Implement asymmetrical 'Bento' or 'Masonry' layouts for the Work Showcase.
Images/Canvas must not block scroll events on mobile devices.

navbar.style: Glassmorphism: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/40 border-b border-white/5
navbar.links: Space Grotesk, text-sm, text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors
navbar.cta: Solid white button, black text, rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold hover:scale-105 transition-transform

hero_3d.material: MeshPhysicalMaterial with clearcoat=1, roughness=0.1, transmission=0.9, thickness=0.5
hero_3d.lighting: Studio lighting, directional light, ambient light, and Environment preset='city'
hero_3d.interaction: Object gently rotates and responds to mouse coordinates (useFrame lerp)
hero_3d.layout: Absolute inset-0, z-0. Text content overlays it relative z-10 pointer-events-none (enable pointer events only on buttons).

infinite_marquee.text: text-6xl md:text-8xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter text-transparent

services_cards.animation: 3D Tilt effect using framer-motion (onMouseMove mapping to rotateX, rotateY)
services_cards.surface: Crystal glass variant: bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:bg-white/[0.04] transition-colors
services_cards.glow: Hover should reveal a subtle purple radial gradient glow in the background.

contact_form.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-purple-500 py-4 w-full outline-none transition-colors text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 rounded-none
contact_form.button: mt-8 w-full md:w-auto px-8 py-4 bg-white text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full hover:bg-purple-500 hover:text-white transition-all duration-300

motion_and_interaction.scroll: MUST use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Staggered text reveal on Hero headline (split text into words/chars, animate y and opacity).
motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveals: Framer motion whileInView: opacity 0 to 1, y: 40 to 0, duration 0.8s, ease [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion using useReducedMotion hook from framer-motion.

hero_fallback.usage: Use as a fallback background or texture map if WebGL fails.

work_project_1.alt: Dark mode mobile app dashboard UI
work_project_1.usage: Work Showcase section, primary project image.

work_project_2.usage: Work Showcase section, secondary project image.

work_project_3.alt: Smartphone displaying apps in dim lighting
work_project_3.usage: Work Showcase section, tertiary project image.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, accordion triggers) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case based on role.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over 3D canvas remains highly legible. Apply a subtle radial gradient dark overlay behind the text if necessary.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize React app with Tailwind CSS.
2. Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react.
3. Fetch 'Unbounded' and 'Space Grotesk' fonts from Google Fonts.
4. Build the immersive 3D Hero using a TorusKnot geometry. The canvas must sit behind the text, and pointer events on the canvas should only track mouse movement (do not block scrolling).
5. Build the text staggered reveal for 'We Build Digital Dimensions.'
7. Construct the Work Showcase with the provided placeholder project images.
8. Build 3D Tilt Cards for the Services section.
